purpose: D10 warm/cold lookup split vs D9 and direct D8; retain D7 true-write reference; complete close/destroy endpoint measurement
pairing: before=D9, after=D10; *_reference before=D8; native_original before=D7; cold_perturbation both D10 with before plain/after profiled. No multiplying prior ratios.
sampling: Eight independent process pairs per bucket; rotating buckets/alternating order; rate >=200ms, fixed lifecycle 256 cycles and >=100ms cycle wall. No concurrent build/tests/profiler. Retain every pair; stop on errors, short windows, wrong loader/counters or changed identities.
guard: One captured view retained outside rate window. Every timed operation pins/unpins K warm native pages and touches one byte/page. Capture/root release/close separate. Component M, not full-session resident E.
cold: 64-page write/publish to fresh generations then first read K0/1/16. CPU/tiles3 BPP4/16. Shared read/write/transfer/retire gates unchanged. Count checks and Qt correctness overhead included on both sides.
lifecycle: Rate window stops at operation/session release; setup, close and actual facade/provider container destruction separate. lifecycle_ns now covers configure through final destructor. Global tiles3 pool/worker full drain remains NotMeasured. Fixed cycles enable equal-work destruction/whole-window comparisons; do not call inverse fixed-work time sustained throughput.
profile: Separate cold_profile D9/D10 and D8/D10 inclusive diagnostic intervals; cold_perturbation paired D10 plain/profile calibrates clocks. Do not attribute phase sums to pure binding/lock self or single-event tails.
limitations: Exploratory paired bootstrap only; no pre-frozen NI margin, upstream current comparison, event tails, high-H/concurrent performance or GPU/UMA qualification. Production treatment isolates warm/cold discovery and has an extra cold shard lookup. Layout/code-placement effects remain possible; no causal attribution of entire rect delta to handle initialization.
